rows.behavior: The root README is a short map (under 80 lines) that links packages/kmctl/README.md, packages/kmaudit/README.md and docs/, and every relative link in the three READMEs resolves.
rows.fails_when: the root README runs to 80 lines or more, misses a link to either package README or docs/, or any README link points at a missing file

rows.behavior: packages/kmctl/README.md tells a user how to install and use kmctl: the CLI install line, the apm.yml entry, the harness sections, upgrade and remove, and links into docs/; the tests that read kmctl's install lines read them there.
rows.fails_when: kmctl's README lacks any of those, or a docs test still reads kmctl's install lines from the root README

rows.behavior: kmaudit's command reference lives at docs/reference/kmaudit-commands.md with docs front matter, documents every kmaudit MCP tool and command, packages/kmaudit/docs/ is gone, and kmctl check passes with the indexes regenerated.
rows.fails_when: packages/kmaudit/docs/ remains, the page lacks a tool or command, or kmctl check reports an error or warning

rows.behavior: release.py set pins kmctl's install lines in packages/kmctl/README.md and set --package kmaudit pins the tracing line in docs/reference/kmaudit-commands.md; release_paths gives docs pages named kmaudit-* to kmaudit and not kmctl; the release workflow stages the moved files.
rows.fails_when: a pin targets an old path, a kmaudit docs page counts for kmctl, or the workflow stages a path that no longer exists
rows.command: uv run pytest tests/scripts/test_release.py tests/scripts/test_release_paths.py tests/scripts/test_workflows.py -q

rows.behavior: The docs install-line check tells kmaudit's lines from kmctl's, and passes on a copy of the tree after set --package kmaudit 0.2.0.
rows.fails_when: a pinned kmaudit line is held to kmctl's subdirectory, or the check fails after a kmaudit pin
